description: Exact inherited tests with proven shared-process order sensitivity. Each remains mandatory and runs in a fresh pytest subprocess once per Python version; none is treated as a frontend replacement.

isolated_tests.reason: The pinned upstream test depends on prior process-global config state: removing one obsolete frontend assertion changes a test boundary and makes this node fail in the shared shard, while the same node passes 20/20 in fresh processes and its complete three-test file passes. Run it fresh so the backend concurrency contract remains mandatory without relying on unrelated frontend test ordering.
